subject: plot of UnmarkedFrameOccu object don't match with operational time of cameras

messages.author: 658c36b8308f59e2
messages.subject: plot of UnmarkedFrameOccu object don't match with operational time of cameras
parts:
Hi! I'm Romina, a student who is trying to finish her bachelor thesis about use of habitat of a cat in Argentina. I have been running single season models with different covariates, i obtained results but then, by an advice of my director of use less data so to reduce the NA's I realized that the plot of the unmarkedframeoccu didn't match with the time the cameras were operating (as i though it was). My question is if there is something in my code that it's wrong and causes this or if it's my lecture of the plot what was wrong (i supposed the observations where ordered by time but now I'm doubting).

My code is:
CT<-read.csv2("CT_2019.csv") #Dataset with camera sampling periods
Cam_Op2019 <- cameraOperation(CTtable = CT,
                                stationCol = "Station",
                                setupCol = "Setup_date",
                                retrievalCol = "Retrieval_date",
                                hasProblems = TRUE,
                                camerasIndependent = TRUE,
                                dateFormat = "dmy HM",
)

g<-read.csv2("g_2019.csv") #record table of my species of interest
Det_Hist <- detectionHistory(recordTable = g,
                              camOp = Cam_Op2019,
                              output = "binary",
                              stationCol = "Station",
                              speciesCol = "Species",
                              species = "gato",
                              recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
                              recordDateTimeFormat = "dmy HM",
                              occasionLength = 5,
                              day1 = "station",
                              includeEffort = FALSE,
                              datesAsOccasionNames = FALSE,
                              timeZone = "America/Buenos_Aires",
                              writecsv = FALSE
)

det_hist<-as.matrix(Det_Hist$detection_history)

sitecovs<-read.csv2("Covariables fijas_2019.csv", row.names = "Station") #My site covs
sitecovs.<- mutate_if(sitecovs, is.numeric, scale, center=T) # I standarized all the numeric variables

#I made the unmarked frame
umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=det_hist, siteCovs=sitecovs., obsCovs=NULL) 
plot(umf)

To see wich site was each row I called de dataframe umf, and pasted the part of observation in an excel beside the camera data, like this: 


As you can see there are cameras in the firsts occasions which appears as operating but they weren't

I would really apreciate your help!

Best regards, Romina.
